title: Count tiles show 0 when there is nothing to count
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in a location (workplace) with nothing in it: no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).
  4. A second location exists with two walk-in part sales (no customer) invoiced in it (for example ZZAUTOTEST Walk-in Shop, each sale with one part, e.g. Sell Price $25.00).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. Create nothing in it.
  • For 4: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Walk-in Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list; switch to it; Parts > Part Sales > New Part Sale, leave the customer empty (walk-in), add a part (e.g. Sell Price $25.00) and invoice it; do this twice. If the build does not allow a sale with no customer, write in the result comment that a walk-in sale could not be created, and skip the last result.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop selected.
  2. Look at Sales by Customer and At Risk Customers for any up/down arrow or change figure.
  3. Look beside the At Risk Customers title for an arrow icon or report link.
  4. Read the Sales by Customer headline (Last 12 Months).
  5. Read the At Risk Customers headline (120 Days).
  6. Change location to ZZAUTOTEST Walk-in Shop (profile icon > Change Location) and read the Sales by Customer headline. Then click View details on the tile.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Neither count tile shows a change indicator. The trend line is the only comparison.
  • At Risk Customers has no arrow icon or report link.
  • Sales by Customer reads "0 customers" (no sales in the range).
  • At Risk Customers reads "0" (nobody at risk).
  • In ZZAUTOTEST Walk-in Shop the two walk-in sales are counted together as one "no company" customer: the headline reads "1 customer", not 2, and the table shows a single no-company row with 2 invoices.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9577 (Story 5, Count Tiles, Sales by Customer and At Risk Customers); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 5. Design canvas board 15_Empty_Design (row 15) shows "0 customers" and "0".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N1: “No count tile shows a delta indicator; the sparkline is the only comparison.”
  • S5-N2: “The At Risk Customers tile does not show a report link, because there is no At Risk report.”
  • S5-E1: “If no customers had sales in the selected range, the Sales by Customer headline shows 0.”
  • S5-E2: “If no customers are at risk in the selected window, the At Risk Customers headline shows 0.”
  • S5-E3: “Sales made on an invoice with no company are counted together as a single "no company" customer in the Sales by Customer count.”
  • S5-E3 context note: “QA should expect to create the case rather than find it.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
